aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Bavarian detectives Franz Eberhofer and Rudi Birkenberger investigate a high-stakes conflict at Niederkaltenkirchen's new golf course, quickly finding themselves ensnared in a fierce feud between two rival folk festival clans.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When a new golf course opens in Niederkaltenkirchen, local detective Franz Eberhofer and his eccentric partner Rudi Birkenberger are called in to investigate a chaotic new case. They quickly discover that the crime is inextricably linked to an escalating clash between two powerful folk festival dynasties. As tension mounts on and off the fairway, the duo must decipher family secrets and local rivalries to restore order. With their trademark Bavarian humor and unorthodox methods, Franz and Rudi navigate a web of colorful suspects.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The quiet Bavarian town of Niederkaltenkirchen is upended by the grand opening of a controversial local golf course, which immediately becomes the backdrop for Franz Eberhofer's latest investigation. Joined by his overly enthusiastic partner Rudi Birkenberger, Franz looks into a mystery that plunges them directly into the center of a bitter, long-standing family feud. The rivalry involves two prominent folk festival clans who are fighting fiercely for dominance, prestige, and commercial control over the region's lucrative festivities. As Franz tries to maintain his laid-back lifestyle, Rudi pushes for rigorous detective work, leading to constant humorous friction between the two long-time friends. Their investigation takes them from country club greens to beer tent backrooms as they interrogate a colorful cast of eccentric local suspects. Each clue uncovers deeper layers of petty vendettas, sabotage, and comedic miscommunications deeply rooted in Bavarian tradition. Despite the chaotic interference of family politics and personal distractions, Franz's sharp instincts slowly bring the truth to light. Ultimately, the mismatched investigative team manages to untangle the convoluted plot, exposing the culprit while keeping Niederkaltenkirchen's delicate social order intact.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Steckerlfischfiasko brings back beloved Bavarian police inspector Franz Eberhofer and his trusty sidekick Rudi Birkenberger for another humorously chaotic investigation. Set against the backdrop of Niederkaltenkirchen's newly constructed golf course, the film weaves classic crime-procedural elements with sharp regional comedy. What begins as a localized disturbance rapidly escalates into a full-blown war between two influential folk festival dynasties whose long-simmering animosity explodes into the public eye. Balancing dry wit, eccentric character dynamics, and authentic Bavarian culture, this spoiler-free installment explores how tradition clashes with modern developments, forcing Franz and Rudi to navigate a maze of petty grudges, local politics, and family secrets to solve the case.
